travel: The quickest way to get here is by using the Ectophial. Alternatively, players can teleport to the Canifis lodestone and run east to Port Phasmatys.
requirements:
* 
* Completion of Underground Pass
* Completion of The Curse of Zaros (miniquest)

clue: Have an idea inside the Invention Guild
title: Have an idea inside the Invention Guild. Beware of double agents! Equip a lab coat top, lab coat legs and a staff of light.
image: Emote clue Idea Invention Guild.png
travel: Recoloured and augmented versions of the staff can be used. Use a skills necklace to teleport directly outside the guild door, or teleport to the Falador lodestone to get here.

clue: Headbang inside the Slayer Tower
title: Headbang inside the Slayer Tower. Beware of double agents! Equip an imphide hood, a Prifddinian musician's robe top and an amulet of magic.
image: Emote Clue Headbang Slayer Tower.png
travel:
The fastest way to get to the Slayer Tower is to use the ring of slaying, the Mask of Broken Fingers, the Mask of the Abyss, the Mask of Stench, or the Mask of Mourning. Alternatively:
* Dungeoneering cape to the Morytania Slayer Tower dungeon
* Teleport to the Canifis lodestone and then run west
* Fairy ring code to a spot just south of the Slayer Tower.

clue: Jig in the Edgeville Monastery garden
title: Jig in the Edgeville Monastery garden. Beware of double agents! Equip a holy cithara, Saradomin's murmur and a ring of devotion.
image: Emote clue Jig Edgeville Monastery.png
travel:
* Edgeville lodestone teleport
* Wilderness sword Edgeville teleport

clue: Salute in the Max Guild Garden
title: Salute in the Max Guild Garden. Beware of double agents! Have no items equipped when you do.
image: Emote clue Salute Max Guild garden.png
travel:
* Max guild Teleport and exit into the garden
* Attuned crystal teleport seed to teleport to the Cadarn district.
requirements:
* Quest Cape or level 99 in any skill
* Completion of Plague's End

clue: Shrug in the Lumbridge Fishing Supplies shop
title: Shrug in the Lumbridge Fishing Supplies shop. Beware of double agents! Equip demon slayer gloves, a boater and the cape of legends.
image: Emote clue Shrug Lumbridge Fishing Supplies.png
travel:
Any colour of boater will work.
* Lumbridge lodestone teleport

clue: Think in the Hefin district of Prifddinas
title: Think in the Hefin district of Prifddinas. Beware of double agents! Equip an ancient staff, Prifddinian worker's trousers and a berserker ring.
image: Emote clue Think Hefin district.png
travel:
The enhanced ancient staff works, as do the recoloured variants. 
* Attuned crystal teleport seed to the Hefin district
* Prifddinas lodestone and run north-west
requirements:
* Completion of Plague's End
* Completion of Desert Treasure
